rows: How this workbook works
Refreshed automatically every day at ~9 AM IST. Last refresh: 25 Nov 2026, 20:02 IST.

Sources: post list, likes, comments, captions and video length from the Meta (Instagram) connector. Reach, impressions/views, shares, saves, stories, average watch time, follows and new-follower counts from Meta Business Suite insights (Instagram).
Column definitions
Creative type — Reel, Static post, Carousel, Story.
Content category — Series promo, Launch / teaser, Festive tie-in promo, Festive greeting, Topical / trend, Meme / humour, Celebrity / podcast, Behind the scenes, App / brand promo.
Engagement rate — (likes + comments + shares + saves) ÷ reach.

Hook score (est.) — how far past the opening seconds the average viewer stays: avg watch time of 12s+ (or 60% of a short reel) = 10. Instagram only shows true retention graphs / skip rate in its mobile app, so this is estimated from average watch time.
Mid-roll score (est.) — watch-through (avg watch time ÷ length) ranked against our other reels of similar length: 10 = best on the account, 5 = typical.
Cliffhanger score (est.) — end-of-video actions (follows + shares + saves + comments per reach) ranked against our other reels: 10 = best on the account.
Audience dropped at — when the average viewer has left, e.g. '7s of 137s (5% watched)'. Same number as 'Drop-off second (s)' and average watch time.
Why we lost the audience — the weakest of hook / mid-roll / cliffhanger; 'CTA / payoff' when all three hold but engagement is still low.
Observation — auto-written each day from the post's numbers vs account benchmarks: what worked, what didn't, what to improve.
Caption & SEO score / review — caption analysis: hook in first line, show name early, searchable Hindi + English keywords, 3–5 relevant hashtags, clean keyword block, CTA, comment prompt.
Status — 'Live' rows update daily. 'Final (no new change)' = older than 14 days and numbers have stopped moving, so the observation is frozen.
Colour key
Blue text = numbers pulled from Instagram/Meta. Black = formulas or analysis. Green→red shading = strong→weak.
YouTube sheets (YT Dashboard, YT Video Log, YT What Works)
Source: YouTube Studio for the TukTuki - Microdrama channel, read in the built-in browser (read-only). Public videos published since 1 Jul 2026; private, unlisted and scheduled uploads are left out.
Format — Short or Video (long video). Views, engaged views, likes, comments, shares, subscribers gained, impressions, CTR, watch time, avg view duration and avg % viewed are lifetime to date.
Hook score — Shorts: YouTube's 'viewed vs swiped away' %; long videos: retention 30 seconds in. Ranked against our other videos of the same format (10 = best on the channel, 5 = typical).
Mid-roll score — how much of the post-hook audience is still there at the halfway point (from the real retention curve), ranked the same way.
Cliffhanger score — how much of the halfway audience reaches 90% of the video, ranked the same way.
Biggest drop at — the second where the retention curve falls fastest after the hook. Average viewer watched — avg view duration vs length.
Why we lost the audience — weakest of hook / mid-roll / cliffhanger; 'Discovery / packaging' when watch behaviour is fine but views are low (title/thumbnail problem).
Title & description SEO — show name + hook in the first 60 characters, hook sentence at the top of the description (not the boilerplate hashtag block), 3–5 relevant hashtags, app link + CTA.
Views index — views ÷ channel median for the same format (Short vs long video). Hit rate in YT What Works = share of videos with index > 1.
